title: IC Substrate Inspection - ESD Damage Detection on ICOS T3/T7
subtitle: Post-Oxidation Quality Validation for 28nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Klaus Weber

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ICOS T3/T7 system to detect and classify ESD Damage defects during post-oxidation inspection at the 28nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab B to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for ESD Damage defects that are critical to yield at the 28nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ICOS T3/T7 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ICOS T3/T7
- Inspection Type: IC Substrate Inspection
- Target Defect: ESD Damage
- Process Step: Post-Oxidation
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 28nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab B

This test case applies to all ICOS T3/T7 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab B for post-oxidation monitoring in the 28nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ICOS T3/T7
Software Version: v15.6.115
Recipe: IC_SUBSTRATE_INSPECTION_28nm_POST_OXIDATION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (145 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ICOS T3/T7 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'IC Substrate Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target ESD Damage defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 28nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 82 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.3% for IC Substrate Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.94 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-11-24
Wafers Tested: 26
Total Defects Found: 1183
Defect Density: 376.56 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.5%
Capture Rate: 90.1%
Test Duration: 261 minutes
System Uptime: 99.4%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ICOS T3/T7 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting ESD Damage at the 28nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) No significant drift was observed during the test duration.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
